purpose: Six planches cartoon pour deux stades visuels de jeu, sans modification des modèles 3D ni du gameplay

sheets.name: La compacte
sheets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE polished landscape 2D cartoon game-asset model reference sheet for La compacte. The attached image is the reference for this variety's identity, palette, leaf shapes and pot, NOT an edit target. Match its bold black ink outlines, flat saturated colors, simple subtle cel shading and adult sci-fi cartoon style, consistent with our Rick and Morty-like game art. broad compact dark forest-green foliage, green lime tiny buds, short straight trunk, round tapered terracotta orange pot.
Exactly TWO development stages, each consistently drawn in four coherent views. White background, clean framed grid of TWO ROWS by FOUR COLUMNS. Top row: "PETITE POUSSE" immediately after player planting, tiny short thin stem, two small rounded cotyledons and one pair of small serrated young leaves, no buds at all. Bottom row: "EN CROISSANCE", plant foliage about 65–70 percent of the mature reference plant height ABOVE SOIL, several shorter branches and small offshoots with reduced-size palmate leaves, visibly fuller than seedling but smaller and less developed than reference mature plant. Several clearly visible MINIATURE nascent bud clusters, only around one-quarter of mature bud size, no large mature colas. Not just a scaled adult: thinner stems, small leaves, immature branching. Preserve the same full-size pot in both stages and all views, same soil, pot shape/colors. Columns labeled "FACE", "PROFIL", "DOS", "DESSUS" in both rows. All side views orthographic and aligned soil line, same scale, full plant and pot shown without cropping, top view correctly shows same foliage structure. The top row seedlings MUST be visibly tiny above the unchanged full-size pots, do not enlarge seedlings to fill cell. Top-down views use same scale as other views. Elegant readable French title "La compacte — DEUX STADES". No mature third stage, no cultivation tips, no lighting/nutrient/time schedules, no characters, no photorealism, no watermark. This is concept art for future 3D game props, not a game screenshot.
